enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Holy 5: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 5d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Unnatural Bane 5: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt beings that should not exist, dealing an additional 5d10 bane damage vs. Aberrations, Monstrous Humanoids, and Undead.

Ghostbane 5: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt the risen dead, dealing an additional 5d10 bane damage vs. Undead monsters.Passive: This weapon has Ghost Touch, and bypasses ethereal monster's 50% chance to evade bane damage.

Silver: A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires. Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
